grammar_rules.rule_name: Lequel, laquelle, lesquels, lesquelles after prepositions
grammar_rules.summary: After prepositions, use lequel (masculine singular), laquelle (feminine singular), lesquels (masculine plural), lesquelles (feminine plural) for specific things; can also be used for people but less common.
grammar_rules.explanation: C’est l’antiquaire à qui je pensais. (Less common: C’est l’antiquaire auquel je pensais.) C’est le tableau auquel je pensais. C’est le client pour lequel je travaille. C’est la société pour laquelle je travaille. Les outils avec lesquels il travaille appartenaient à son père.
restrictions: qui cannot be used with parmi
exceptions: à and de contract with the lequel forms (auquel, auxquels, auxquelles, duquel, desquels, desquelles)
qui cannot be used after parmi
For people, qui is more common than lequel after a preposition
agreement_rules: Lequel agrees in gender and number with its antecedent: lequel/laquelle/lesquels/lesquelles.
Contracted forms auquel/auxquels/auxquelles and duquel/desquels/desquelles keep the same gender and number agreement.
common_traps: Use auquel, auxquels, auxquelles after à; duquel, desquels, desquelles after de.

sources.source_text: C’est le tableau auquel je pensais.

grammar_rules.summary: Qui is used after a preposition to refer only to people.
grammar_rules.explanation: Voici le collègue avec qui j’écris le rapport. Je vous présente la personne sans qui je n’aurai pas pu réussir.
usage: object of preposition referring to people
exceptions: qui after a preposition cannot be used with parmi
Only people are referred to; for things the lequel forms are used
Prepositions such as avec, sans, and pour require qui, not que
agreement_rules: Qui is invariable and takes no gender or number agreement with its antecedent.
Qui is used for people after a preposition, unlike lequel, which marks gender and number.
transformations: sans qui je n'aurai pas pu réussir

sources.source_text: Voici le collègue avec qui j’écris le rapport.

grammar_rules.rule_name: Quoi after prepositions for indefinite things
grammar_rules.summary: Quoi is used after a preposition to refer to an indefinite thing or object.
grammar_rules.explanation: Tu sais à quoi il pense?
usage: object of preposition referring to indefinite things
exceptions: Refers only to indefinite things, not to people
qui is used instead when a person is meant
agreement_rules: Quoi is invariable and takes no gender or number agreement.
Quoi refers to indefinite things only, so no antecedent agreement applies.
transformations: Tu sais à quoi il pense?
Je ne sais pas de quoi il parle.
